decisions.reason: Having survived the first review while other weaker close-to-core variants were culled, this design-led finish range likely meets or is close enough to aspirations that management keeps it as a low-cost complement to the core portfolio.

This shower channel remains tightly aligned with the firm's core drainage business and barrier-free, seamless-bathroom demand, so current performance is likely acceptable enough to justify continued learning and support.

The technically more complex pump-assisted line is most likely to fall short of aspiration levels in a niche segment, and with a newer pump-drain offer now available management would reallocate resources to the stronger core and newer development.
As the newest pump-related launch, it is still within the period where boundedly rational management uses available slack to test market acceptance before making a harsher exit decision.
